prompt: An account starts with 200 followers and gains 100 new followers every week — the same amount each time. How many followers after 3 weeks?
hint: The account gains the same number of followers each week. Is that adding or multiplying growth?

hints.text: The account gains the same number of followers each week. Is that adding or multiplying growth?
This is linear growth, so start with $200$ and add $100$ for each of the $3$ weeks: $200 + 3 \times 100$.
$3 \times 100 = 300$ and $200 + 300 = 500$, so the account has $500$ followers after $3$ weeks.

explanation: Gaining the same amount every week is linear growth, which adds a constant each step.
The rule is followers $= 200 + 100w$, and at $w = 3$ this is $200 + 300$.
Adding gives $500$, so the account has $500$ followers after three weeks.

alternativeExplanations.title: Week-by-week table
steps: Each row climbs by exactly 100 — a straight staircase to 500.

alternativeExplanations.title: Picture a straight ramp
steps: On a graph, linear growth is a straight line starting at 200 and rising 100 per week.
Three equal steps up from 200 lands at 500.
